name: Advanced Parry
effect: When parrying multiple hits, distribute DoS among any amount of attackers. Penalties (e.g. resulting from \emph{Feint}) are summed up.

name: Alpha Strike
prerequisites: From The Shadows, no Beta Strike
effect: Successfully attacking an unaware target automatically hits critically.

name: Assassin Strike
effect: Scoring a critical hit or deathblow in melee allows the character to move up to his speed in meters right away without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Augsmith
effect: The character is capable of making and repairing cybernetic implants.

name: Bar Fighter
effect: Ignore \emph{Improvised} penalties. This obviously does not make the object more durable.

name: Battle Mind
effect: The character may add a tenth of his Intelligence to \emph{Base Initiative}.

name: Battle Sense
effect: Adds a fifth of Perception Bonus (2, 4, or 8) to initiative. Doubles penalties to attacks of opportunity against the character.

name: Beta Strike
effect: The user gains +10 to hit any character that has already attacked him during this combat encounter.

name: Blind Fighting
effect: Limits the penalties for being blinded in melee combat to -10.

name: Blurry
effect: While sprinting the character imposes a -20 to everyone trying to hit him.

name: Broken
effect: Grants +30 to fear and pinning tests, but doubles penalties from bad reputation or disposition.

name: Butcher
effect: Base damage dealt with blades is increased by 1 for one-handed weapons and 2 for two-handed weapons.

name: Calming Presence
effect: The character may take an action to make an Appeal test at a +20 bonus. For every degree of success all allies he addresses gain a +10 to tests to resist fear and pinning.

name: Clear Target
effect: Halves penalties for attacking small targets with ranged attacks.

name: Clotter
effect: When starting to bleed, make a toughness check at a -10 penalty. On a success the character doesn't bleed.

name: Combat Focus
effect: While in combat, re-roll one failed fear or pinning test per turn.

name: Companion
effect: The character may adopt a small companion. Details can be found in the GM companion.

name: Dominion
effect: When taking a Defensive Stance and not moving, the control area is increased to 360°. The character may also take Attacks of Opportunity against \emph{disengaging} enemies.

name: Drunken Master
effect: Limits the penalty to melee combat resulting from chemical detriments to -10. While intoxicated he himself is at a -20 to hit and can use maneuvers as normal.\\ Costs half as much for \textit{balanced} characters.

name: Dual Wielding
effect: Halves penalties for dual wielding. Has to be taken once for melee and once for ranged separately.

name: Earth Shaker
effect: Base damage dealt with blunt weapons is increased by 1 for one-handed weapons or 2 for two-handed weapons.

name: Executioner
effect: Grants +10 to hit bleeding targets.

name: Expert Wrestler
effect: The character is incredibly well-trained in grappling. He can initiate a Hold as a free action, as a part of another grappling maneuver.

name: Face Breaker
effect: Grants unarmed strikes the \emph{Trauma} special rule.

name: Fighting Retreat
effect: Allows a single standard melee attack to be made when disengaging. This attack counts as being performed in movement.

name: Flip Up
effect: When standing up, reduce the time it takes by an action: prone to standing now takes one action or a free action and a successful agility test.

name: Focused Frenzy
effect: When the character is made to go berserk by some means, they can identify friend and foe. When no foes are left and the \emph{Frenzy} does not end, friends still become valid targets.

name: Formation
effect: When taking Combined Actions, everyone involved is granted a +10, up to +30 when three or more characters have Formation. When \emph{Unbreakable Bond} partners also have Formation, those two gain an additional +10.

name: From The Shadows
effect: During the first round of combat the character has 6 additional initiative, unless the character was ambushed or similarly caught off guard.

name: Gruesome
effect: When destroying body locations or landing a killing blow, the character makes an \emph{Intimidation} test with a bonus equal to twice the last attack's damage. All enemies must make a Fear test, suffering a penalty equal to 10 + 5 per DoS.

name: Hand-To-Hand Basics
effect: When fighting armed enemies, the character counts as armed as well. Unarmed fighting loses the \emph{Improvised} rule.

name: Hax0r e1337
effect: Add two Degrees of Success to any Wirewalk tests to crack other devices or protect your own.

name: Heroic
effect: Grants +15 to resist Fear and Pinning.

name: High Noon
effect: When drawing a pistol, the character may take a single shot as part of the drawing action.

name: Iron Fist
effect: Unarmed strikes may now count as a having Stun(0) without inferring a penalty.

name: Lead Storm
effect: Weapons with a fire rate of more than 1 which are not launchers may be \emph{braced} as part of an \emph{Aim} action.

name: Light Sleeper
effect: The character may benefit from \emph{Overly Cautious} when sleeping or intoxicated.

name: Marksman
effect: Halves penalties for long ranges.

name: Medical Insight
effect: Doubles the degrees of success on Bio-Maintenance tests to help others recover.

name: Mighty Companion
effect: The character may adopt a powerful companion. Details can be found in the GM companion.

name: Mobile Combat
effect: Halves penalties for fighting while moving. This includes a Charge maneuver's flat penalty if the character also has \emph{Maneuver: Charge}.

name: Natural Geek
effect: The character can add their Education's full bonus, regardless of it surpassing the Skill's bonus.

name: On Your Feet!
effect: The character may take an action to make an Intimidation. On a success an ally gains a +5 per Degree of Success to any action following the character's orders.

name: One-Man Artillery
effect: Launchers may be \emph{braced} as part of an \emph{Aim} action.

name: Overly Cautious
effect: The character becomes jittery or nervous, but when attacked he can ignore \emph{Unaware} conditions by passing a +20 Perception check, so long as he is not asleep, intoxicated or otherwise impaired.

name: Perfectionist Craftsman
effect: Doubles the degrees of success on crafting tests.

name: Personified Inspiration
effect: When the character does a daring or heroic deed, all allies present are immune to fear and pinning for the rest of the encounter or scene. Whatever counts as daring or heroic is up to GM discretion.

name: Precision Strike
effect: Halves penalties for attacking small targets with melee attacks.

name: Protective Stance
effect: When taking a Defensive Stance, the character may turn active actions into reactions without penalties and he may parry for allies within his melee range.

name: Provoke
effect: The character may taunt an enemy as an action, making a fitting skill test opposed by the target's \emph{Restraint}. If the character wins, the target must attack the character at the next opportunity.

name: Quick Draw
effect: Draw smaller equipment pieces, pistols and one-handed melee weapons as a free action.

name: Rapid Reload
effect: When reducing reload time to below 1 action, reload as a free action.

name: Reliable Reputation
effect: Halves penalties from bad disposition, so long diplomacy is at all still possible.

name: Render
effect: When dealing damage with the \emph{Tearing} rule, roll an additional dice. Still only keep one.

name: Revenge
effect: When taking damage from a direct attack while \emph{frenzied}, you may forego one of your actions later in the combat round to immediately attack the offending enemy.

name: Ripper
effect: When dealing damage with the Tearing rule and rolling doubles, you may choose those two dice (instead of keeping just one).

name: Sidearm
effect: When attacking in melee combat with a melee weapon in one hand and a pistol in the other, the character takes no penalties from shooting in melee combat.

name: Skull Taker
effect: Removes penalties from calling hit locations for ranged attacks (when combined with Clear Target) or melee attacks (when combined with Precision Strike).

name: Snapshot
effect: Aiming bonuses accumulate twice as fast.

name: Stabilization
effect: The character is able to staunch light bleeding on others in one round without equipment.

name: Steadfast
effect: Tests to prevent falling gain a +10.

name: Steady Aim
effect: When aiming, line of sight may be broken for a round without aiming being interrupted. By GM discretion this may count even longer if the target is moving particularly predictably.

name: Strong Back
effect: The character's carry weight is increased by half.

name: Supreme Awareness
effect: Roll twice when determining initiative or \{Gathering Senses}, picking the higher result.

name: Tactical Advance
effect: While advancing carefully from one cover to the next over a distance of \emph{MS} meters in one turn, the character counts as in cover for the whole way.

name: The Best Defense
effect: Reduces offensive penalties of Defensive Stance by 20.

name: Thick Skull
effect: Grants immunity to the \emph{Trauma} special rule and resisting the \emph{Stun} special rule gains +10.

name: Threatening Presence
effect: Impose a -15 penalty to enemies' tests against Fear and Intimidation.

name: Too Angry To Die
effect: While \emph{frenzied}, the character has to take at least 8 damage at once or lose his head in order to die. Bleeding out only starts when the character stops frenzying, but he will in this case be unconscious when frenzy ends.

name: Trained Sense
effect: Grants a +10 bonus to sensory checks using that sense. May be acquired once for every sense.

name: Unbreakable Bond
prerequisites: being good friends; if one is \emph{Clumsy} and the other is \emph{Cursed by Fortuna}, the cost is only 100 XP
effect: When around one particular close friend, that friend may make a +20 charisma check as a free action and every degree of success gives the character +10 to resist fear and pinning, as well as potentially the effects of disabling characteristics. If both of them have Unbreakable Bond, the bonus to the charisma check is +40 instead.

name: Unquestioned
effect: Penalties to Social Tests resulting from the target's disbelief in authority (e.g. represented by Rebel or some Bound by Principle) do not apply.

name: Unrestrained Reflexes
effect: The character may make an additional dodge action using the same reaction. This may happen once per turn.

name: Vault
effect: The character can use suitable objects or features in the environment to double jump height and leap length during movement without slowing down.

name: Volume of Fire
effect: When using a weapon with a rate of fire above 1 to take a standard shot, the character may spend more ammunition to gain a +5 to hit per shot fired after the first, up to the weapon's rate of fire.

name: Walk It Off
effect: The character can continue acting while bleeding, until completely bled out. If combined with \emph{Tough as Nails}, the character may enter a \emph{Frenzy} when bleeding as well.

name: Where It Hurts
effect: The character's unarmed attacks may gain the \emph{Tearing} special rule.
